explanation: Nonzero only at GO when the agent chooses a1; it is 0 at every D1 and D2 and almost always 0 when choosing a2 (at most about 3). At GO with a1 it is about 10 when the previous trial was a1 to S1 (common) and rewarded, after a streak of these (about 8 early in the episode or right after a switch), about 6 if that previous common trial was unrewarded, and about 0-1 if the previous trial had a rare transition and was unrewarded or was the second rewarded rare trial in a row (a single rewarded rare trial gives about 7-9).
